assets.prompt: Create a production BACKGROUND PLATE for the SAVE GAME archive page of the same refined Chinese fantasy game as the reference. Wide 16:10 full-screen. No UI, no words, no buttons, no letters, no characters, no frames or watermark. A calm dark ink-blue and charcoal courtyard archive pavilion at night. Two very soft shadowy bookcase/lattice silhouettes only at far left and far right, with warm low amber lamps at far edges, light fog, a quiet stone floor at bottom. Hint of bound deep-red thread folios and scrolls at lower-left edge, sparse small cherry blossoms on a thin branch entering only the upper-right corner. Center 75% of frame is very unobtrusive softly shaded blue-black negative space for multiple save cards to overlay, no table through center, no busy patterns. Low contrast and subtle 3D atmospheric perspective; tactile materials, dignified, intimate and mystical. Match the approved screenshot's muted red/gold/blue-gray mood. Create ONE production game UI SAVE SLOT CARD texture, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Landscape 3:1 aspect, one single card centered with alpha padding around. NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO ICONS, NO PORTRAIT, NO BAKED CHARACTER, NO WATERMARK. Match reference's high-end Chinese fantasy interface, restrained red thread and sakura accents. Not parchment-white, not chunky armor plate, not ornate jeweled frame. No external scene. Preserve true alpha everywhere outside the card. Highest available visual fidelity.
